description.zh:
作业ID列表。JobId可以通过[GetPlayInfo](~~56124~~)接口中返回的PlayInfo结构体中获取。

> 多个ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多可以查询10个作业ID。
description.en:
The list of job IDs. You can obtain the job ID from the PlayInfo parameter in the response to the [GetPlayInfo](~~56124~~) operation.

>  You can specify a maximum of 10 job IDs in a request. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

title.zh: 查询智能标签或视频DNA作业

descriptions.zh:
- 视频DNA支持的服务地域：**华北2（北京）**、**华东2（上海）**、**新加坡**。
- 智能标签支持的服务地域：**华北2（北京）**、**华东2（上海）**。
descriptions.en:
*   Regions that support this operation: **China (Beijing)**, **China (Shanghai)**, and **Singapore**.
*   You can call this operation to query video fingerprinting jobs and smart tagging jobs.
